collection.title: MAN TGE Cab 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a MAN TGE Cab 2017 Onwards model which requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 26" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
